newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares end mixed, awaits 3rd qtr GDP.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares end mixed, awaits 3rd qtr GDP.

text.p: The Singapore stock market ended mixed in lacklustre trade on Monday with most investors sidelined, dealers said.

"Most investors will remain sidelined given a lack of clear trend," a dealer with a local institution said, adding that sentiment was cautious ahead of the U.S. presidential election on Tuesday and the release of Singapore's third quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP) expected mid November.
The Straits Times Industrials Index rose 7.61 points to 2,075.78, boosted by stocks like Cycle & Carriage and Fraser & Neave. The two rose S$0.10 (US$0.07) to S$14.70 and S$14.30 respectively.
Market turnover was light at 96.6 million with losers leading gainers by 225 to 93.
Dealers said Creative's better than expected first quarter results failed to lift other electronic counters significantly.
"Investors are still cautious as that (electronic) market direction is vague," one dealer said. The SES electronic index ended 0.79 point up at 81.70.
Creative Technology led gainers, rising S$0.80 to S$9.80 on 402,850 shares.
